answer: A workable design: meter the marginal energy cost of each new identity against the network's median. A single reused nonce reveals every sibling at once. Because it works by forcing the attacker to duplicate sunk work across every clone, payouts to the cluster are redistributed to the honest peer pool. The network ties the onyx to sunk effort, uses the knoll as an corroborating signal, then requires a zenith before any payout.
